title: Earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or higher in the last 24 hours (7 Oct 2026)

Magnitude 4.9: 114 km SW of Turpan, China, 6 Oct, 11:45 pm IST.
Magnitude 4.8: 85 km ENE of Shikotan, Russia, 6 Oct, 11:17 pm IST.
